name: chopped
blurb: Slang for ugly or uncool; a teen insult that took off on TikTok in 2024–2025
title: Chopped Meaning: What Does Chopped Mean in Slang?
description: Chopped is slang for ugly or uncool. Rooted in AAVE, it spread on TikTok in 2024 with the Chopped Chin meme and became a common 2025 teen insult.
h1: What does chopped mean in slang?
answer: In slang, chopped means unattractive or uncool: calling someone chopped is saying they look rough, ugly or out of style. Dictionary.com says it has roots in African American Vernacular English, and the earliest Urban Dictionary entry with the "ugly" sense dates from December 2014. It spread among teens in late 2024 through TikTok memes, including the "Chopped Chin" clip, and by 2025 it was one of the most common playground insults, often next to unc.

body: Chopped is a blunt verdict on looks or vibe. It can describe a bad haircut, no sleep, a messy outfit or someone who is simply judged unattractive. The opposite word in the same slang set is something like "mogging" or having aura. Saying "I'm chopped" about yourself is common self-deprecation, for example without makeup or glasses.
Spin-offs include choppelganger, a less attractive lookalike of a celebrity, and "optionally chopped", looking rough on purpose before a glow-up video.

A viral tweet jokes that the Mona Lisa is chopped
A TikTok using a LeBron James clip spreads "chopped" memes widely
The "Chopped Chin" meme, built on a 2023 courtside dance video, goes viral and moves to TikTok edits in January 2025
Chopped is everyday teen slang on TikTok, X and Instagram, and dictionaries such as Dictionary.com define it

body.note: The Chopped Chin meme mocks a real teenager's appearance, and Dictionary.com notes it was criticized as rude and insensitive for that reason.

ul: "Stop posting the chopped photo of me."
"Chopped and unc": ugly and old, a double insult teens throw at adults.

body: Chopped is current Gen Alpha and Gen Z slang and still common in comments and school talk. It is an insult, so it lands differently between friends joking and strangers piling on someone's photo. Do not confuse it with the cooking show Chopped or "chopped and screwed", a slowed-down hip-hop remix style.

faq.a: Yes. It means ugly or uncool. Friends use it as teasing, but aimed at a stranger it is simply mean.

faq.q: What is the Chopped Chin meme?
faq.a: A late-2024 meme that used a courtside dance video and joked about a boy's chin. It helped spread the word chopped and was criticized for targeting a real person.
Chopped plus doppelganger: a less attractive lookalike of someone famous.
